out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF THE CLEANUP PROCEDURE AGAIN. PLEASE KEEP A COPY ONSITE. KUMO SUSHI (Inspection Date: 09/28/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at SUSHI BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at SUSHI BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK AT THE END OF THE COOK-LINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 71F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE THE HANDWASHING SINK CAN MEET 100F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN AND RAW EGGS OVER CUT LETTUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND RAW FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE STORED BELOW ANY READY-TO-EAT FOODS LIKE PROVIDE. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION; EHS WILL VERIFY AT THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION..

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS SPICES AND BOTTLES IN WORKING CONTAINERS WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER ARE LABELED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS IN CONTAINERS STORED ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN COOLER AND AT SUSHI BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND WITH SHELVING (NOT MILK CRATES OR SODA CRATES) BY THE TIME OF HTE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: SEAWEED AND LOBSTER SALAD manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE ENSURE THESE CONTAINERS ARE DISCARDED OF AND REPLACED WITH NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT COOLERS BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED TWO NEW ICE MACHINES. OBSERVED ONE WITHOUT A DATA PLATE AND ANOTHER THAT APPEARS TO ONLY BE ETL LISTED.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH SPECIFICATION SHEETS PROVING THESE ICE MACHINES ARE NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. IF THE ICE MACHINES ARE ENOT NSF, THEN THEY MUST BE REMOVED FROM THE ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE ENTIRE BACK KITCHEN AND REMOVE ACCUMULATION OF GRIME AND DEBRIS BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE THE BACK KITCHEN IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED RAW YELLOWTAIL AT 50F, RAW TUNA T 41F, AND SMOKED SALMON AT 50F IN THE RIGHT SUSHI DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FISH TO THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER BELOW THE DISPLAY CASE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL SUSHI DISPLAY CASES ARE KEPT SHUT AND MAINTAINED BETWEEN 34-38F TO ENSURE FOODS STAY AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.corrective_action: PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND TO REMOVE FISH FROM COMMERCIAL VACUUM-PACKAGING OR SLIT THE PACKAGES OPEN WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED FOUR KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP AND TABLES; OBSERVED ICE SCOOPER STORED IN ICE MACHINE WITH HANDLE IN ICE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WAS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: PIC WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTERS FROM ALL THREE VENDORS THE FACILITY USES, HOWEVER, TWO OF THE VENDOR’S LETTERS DO NOT OUTLINE ALL SEAFOOD THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT PURCHASES FROM THEM.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC UNDERSTANDS UPDATED PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTERS SHOULD BE OBTAINED FROM THESE TWO VENDORS WITHIN 10 DAYS. PLEASE EMAIL EHS THE UPDATED LETTERS BY THE 5TH OF DECEMBER.
